title: Tractography-Guided Nerve-Sparing in Prostate Cancer
eligibility:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Histological confirmed diagnosis of prostate cancer (PCa) based on prostate biopsy
* Multidisciplinary indication for radical prostatectomy, validated by the Urology Tumor Board
* No prior treatment of prostate cancer
* Capacity to provide informed consent

Exclusion Criteria:

* Unwillingness to participate.
* Pre-existing impaired sexual function before surgery (IIEF5 Score of ≤21)
* Diagnosis of neuropathy
* Inability to comply with study procedure (e.g. due to language barriers, psychological disorders, dementia, anxiety/claustrophobia during pelvic MRI etc.) or medical contraindications to MRI
